title: The Studio | Trapnest Studio
description: An independent creative playground by Henry. Exploring life, art, science and technology through design, motion and interactive worlds. A Trapnest project.

children: A place for ideas to become experiences.

Trapnest Studio is the creative playground within Trapnest, Henry’s home for life, art, science and technology. It brings together experiments in interaction, visual storytelling and the small details that make a digital experience feel alive.

The journal at henrywithu.com follows the ideas behind these worlds: how light moves, how materials respond, and how code becomes something you can feel. This Studio keeps that same curiosity at its centre.
Begin with a question worth exploring. A material, a movement, a small observation from everyday life. Let the idea find its most natural form.
Give the work a clear point of view. Shape the typography, sound and interaction around one coherent experience, with room for surprise.
Craft the details. Prototype, observe, refine. The space between art and engineering is where a project starts to feel alive.

The nested T brings a simple idea into focus: a space that holds creative possibilities. Vermilion, open space and deliberate typography make up the Studio identity. The film below remains part of the original visual archive.
Design gives an idea a place to live. Typography, layout and tactile interfaces turn an abstract thought into an experience.
Read the Trapnest journal for the thinking behind each experiment, or share an idea with Henry.
Motion gives an idea rhythm. The visual archive gathers animation that informs an appreciation for timing, composition and storytelling. Original creators remain credited.
Sound creates atmosphere. The listening room preserves conversations with filmmakers and animation artists, with original episode identities and audio.
Interactive worlds connect art and engineering. Explore Trapnest experiments in materials, physics and spatial storytelling at henrywithu.com.
An independent project by Henry. Built from a curiosity for design, creative coding and the way technology can turn everyday observations into unexpected experiences.
Have an idea that lives between art and technology? Share a short introduction and a link to your work.
